note: Decatur County park on a Kentucky Lake slough of the Tennessee River, 5 mi E of Parsons. The sites Campspot sells as waterfront sit under trees about 25-30 m back from the water. Boat ramps, pavilion, playground. --Claude
summary: Beech Bend: Chamber page, Campspot record/list/quotes/map, Esri, 3DEP, OSM read. Now booked on Campspot (was phone/cash): $25 every RV type, $20 primitive; 54 RV sites (20/30/50 + water, back-in, 22-33 ft mostly, one 54) + 19 tent; showers, dump; Campspot closes the park 11/1-2/28 (stored year_round). Not waterfront kept; Campspot's 24 'WATERFRONT' sites are under canopy ~25-30 m from the pool line, ~4 m above it -> lakeview candidate.
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront kept (contrary claim checked): Campspot sells 24 sites as WATERFRONT/WATERFRONT POINT (01,03,05,06,07,09,11,13,14,15,17,18,20,22,23,26,27,32,34,36,38,40; 29,30), all nightly. Esri shows the east-row pads as clearings under canopy with a continuous tree band to the shore; 3DEP at 35.61436,-88.04046 has the pad at 113.7 m, ~30 m from the 109.4 m summer-pool line at -88.04011 (bank ~4 m). Under canopy = a view: LAKEVIEW candidate, not an upgrade to lakefront.
